build: Bulk Pack Opening + Text Fit Fixes
notes: Open multiple packs at once, and card text no longer spills past its borders anywhere in the game.
build_name: Bulk Pack Opening + Text Fit Fixes
fixes: Added bulk pack opening: open 5, 10, 25, or all of your packs at once from the pack screen, with results shown in a sortable grid instead of one at a time.
Fixed card names and effect text overflowing past the edges of their cards and buttons across every screen, not just the store.
Fixed a crash when opening packs caused by animations not being cleaned up properly.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
